claim_recommendations.rationale: Only the timesheet case shows a concrete dependent action after unawaited async callbacks; callback syntax alone cannot establish a defect.
A hooks.py controller override declaration alone cannot establish framework-version incompatibility or a behavioural fault.
The sample mixes a real placeholder-construction defect, safely parameterised schema operations, approved exceptions and provenance-dependent dynamic SQL.
Meaningful findings require endpoint reachability plus missing authority evidence; ordinary reads, documented validation and internal lifecycle writes otherwise dominate.
Many cases are genuine unbounded per-item reads, but lifecycle operations, fixed bounds, heterogeneous tables and explicit batching must be excluded.
